pages.text:
The $(l)Magic Star$() is a flying companion that casts spells automatically, available after reaching $(9)level 100$().

It has its own independent spell lists and can automatically cast spells in different modes — attacking enemies, protecting itself, guarding its owner, or executing a routine spell cycle. You can think of it as a "fully automated mage companion."

$(l)How to Create?$()

After reaching level 100, a magic star icon will appear at the bottom-right of the mana bar in the $(9)Spell Weaving Screen$(). $(l)Left-click$() the icon to summon — consuming $(9)5000 mana$() — and the Magic Star will appear above your head.

Make sure you have enough mana before summoning, otherwise nothing will happen.

$(l)Four Action Modes$()

Open the Magic Star's interaction screen (right-click the entity) to switch between action modes:

·$(9)$(l)Follow$(): Follows the owner, hovering about 2 blocks above.
·$(9)$(l)Stay$(): Stays in place, does not move.
·$(9)$(l)Patrol$(): Patrols a small area centered on the current position.
·$(9)$(l)Sleep$(): Stops all behavior, including spellcasting and targeting. Suitable for when you need quiet.

$(l)Four Spell Lists$()

The Magic Star has four independent spell lists, each triggered at different occasions:

·$(9)$(l)Attack Spells$(): Cast when an enemy is locked on.
·$(9)$(l)Self-Defense Spells$(): Cast when threatened (automatically pushes the star's own entity onto the stack when casting).
·$(9)$(l)Guardian Spells$(): Cast when the owner takes damage (automatically pushes the owner entity onto the stack when casting).
·$(9)$(l)Routine Spells$(): Cast in rotation every 20 ticks (automatically pushes the casting coordinate onto the stack when casting).

Spells in each list can be individually $(l)moved up, moved down, disabled, or deleted$(). Disable states are saved per list — disabling a spell in the attack list doesn't affect its state in the self-defense list.

Additionally, spell lists support $(9)delay entries$(): insert a "delay x ticks" entry to control the interval before the next spell is cast.

pages.title: Itemize and Restore
pages.text:
$(l)Itemize:$()
Click the $(9)Itemize$() button at the bottom of the Magic Star interaction screen, and the entity will turn into a $(9)Magic Star Item$() and drop on the spot.

$(l)Restore:$()
Hold the Magic Star item and right-click a block to spawn the entity above it; right-click the air to spawn it above your head. $(l)Only the original owner$() can use it.

$(l)Miscellaneous$()

The Magic Star consumes the player's mana when casting, but when using the [Self] rune, it pushes itself onto the stack rather than the player entity.
